newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-L.Lease on budget for yr profit rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-L.Lease on budget for yr profit rise.

text.p: Financial services and property group Lend Lease Corp Ltd said on Thursday it was on budget to increase its profit after tax and earnings per share in the full year to June 30, 1997.

Lend Lease earlier said its net for the six moths to December 31, 1996 rose 14.2 percent to A$160 million and lifted its interim dividend to 48 cents from 43 cents in the previous corresponding period.
The company said net earnings from its financial services division rose 9.2 percent to A$104.0 million while its property services division recorded an earnings rise of 8.3 percent to A$39.3 million.
Higher earnings were as a result of the strong contribution from the financial services division which was underpinned by buoyant retail sales and investment markets, Lend Lease said.

Lend Lease said the partial sale of its investment in Hoyts Trust saw net earnings from its capital services division more than doubled to A$11.5 million from A$4.2 million in the previous corresponding half.
"Financial services businesses achieved sales of A$1.4 billion (in the half), with retail sales increasing by 52 percent over December 1995 reflecting positive investment markets," the compnay said.
Lend Lease said net policy cash inflows for the retail business rose to A$177 million from A$58 million in the previous first half.
The company said corporate sales and cash flows were lower than in the previous corresponding period.
"The outflows primarily reflected benefit payments and also decisions by superannuation trustees to switch funds including guranteed capital contracts," the company said.
At 10.45 a.m (2345 GMT), Lend Lease shares were 19 cents firmer at A$23.30.
